bundle.shortDescription: A local-first runtime for AI agents that act on your computer.
bundle.longDescription: AgentOS runs AI agents against your own machine under a deny-by-default policy, with human approval as a runtime primitive and an append-only, hash-chained audit log. The desktop application holds no agent logic of its own: it renders what the runtime reports and forwards what a person decides.
